VR.title: Meta Reportedly Plans 4 New Smart Glasses Models Amid Aggressive 10M Unit Push
VR.summary: Meta plans to release four new smart glasses models this year as part of an aggressive push to reach 10 million units sold.

VR.title: Acer Re-enters XR with New AR & Smart Glasses
VR.summary: Acer has re-entered the XR market with the launch of two new AR and smart glasses after a seven-year hiatus.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is available at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play event from May 27 to June 10.

VR.title: ‘No Man’s Sky’ Brings Its Biggest Space Battles to Date in ‘The Swarm’ Update
VR.summary: No Man's Sky has launched 'The Swarm' update, introducing large-scale faction warfare and the biggest space battles in the game's history.

VR.summary: XREAL has launched a new sub-brand in China with the XBX A01, its most affordable XR glasses yet, though trademark disputes loom.

VR.summary: The multiplayer VR shooter Larcenauts will officially shut down in October, ending its 6v6 gameplay experience.

AI.summary: Strava is tightening API access to combat AI scraping, requiring developers to pay for data usage.

AI.summary: Google's Gemini Spark AI agent can perform tasks on behalf of users, but concerns about cost and privacy persist.

AI.summary: Nvidia's entry into the consumer laptop chip market with RTX Spark could redefine performance standards for Windows devices.

NFL.summary: Daniel Jones has progressed to 7-on-7 drills as he recovers from a torn Achilles, marking a positive step in his rehabilitation.

NFL.summary: Texans linebacker E.J. Speed is expected to miss the entire season due to a torn quadriceps injury.

NFL.summary: The Giants have released long snapper Zach Triner as part of their roster moves, which also include signing Odell Beckham.

NFL.title: College Football Playoff first round will again go head-to-head with Saturday NFL games
NFL.summary: The College Football Playoff's first round will coincide with NFL games on a Saturday in December, creating scheduling conflicts.
